string.text: Lookin' ta bash some 'eadz? Da fightin' pitz could use more boyz!
Welcome, lad, are you here for the Grozkazak?
You lookin' for a fight? Well da pitz waitin' so get in there!
Welcome, lad. If you're here for the Grozkazak, I'm afraid you're too late. Won't be any big fights anytime soon.
If ya lookin' for da pitz, go towards da screamin'.
Welcome, lad. I can tell you're good arena material, how can I help?
Still kickin' eh? Good, da ladz need a good fight!
{PLAYER.NAME} ,welcome back.
Lookz like you could use anovva' scrap!
Do you want to have another go, lad?
So 'oo heard 'bout any big fightz round 'ere?
There's a Grozkazak going on right now?
I's 'eard a fing or two bout da big fightz!
The Grozkazak, I've heard of that.
I can see da way ya be holdin ya choppa! If you'z itchin for a fight da pit boyz are waitin!
Right you are, lad. You have the look of a warrior. You should have a go. There is honour to be gained under Grimnir's gaze, even without bloodshed
Best way ta git bos round ere' iz winnin da pitz! Not ta mention da shamanz say Gork n' Mork alwayz be watchin in der!
It's a good chance to make your name and clan known around here, honourable battle before the ancestors. I ask, what can be better?
O' course you 'ave, ya squealin' runt, when we ain't lootin' or killin' we's fightin'!

Every dawi worth their salt has heard of the Grozkazak. Sparring has ever been a custom amongst our kind. Through the years, entrepreneurial dawi figured out they can get good gold for hosting "sparring sessions" on a greater scale. This eventually evolved into the Grozkazak of today
But da boss don't wants us to get maimed, so we's bashing each others 'eads in wiv bitz o' wood instead

Of course, we don't want to shed good dawi blood, so we use weapons that have been blunted and made safe for our people to test their prowess without fear of dying in the arena before they can slay our enemies.
Da boyz group up an' beat da snot out o' each uvva. There ain't much blood, but da boyz'll come out lookin' betta!
It’s team bouts; hard hits, loud cheers, and not many funerals. Crowd may miss the blood, but the lads keep their teeth.
If yoo wants to git known 'round 'ere ya wants to win. Da boyz throw in teef an bits o' scrap to make sure da boyz git a proppa fight
You a dawi, hah? Prove it in the ring and make a name, the gal jingling after is only a bonus.
Wen there's no big fight, da boyz still come to have a scrap to git ready for da next big fight. We's even throw in a few teef if dey does well
Even without a Grozkazak, the hall’s worth a visit. Lads train here all day, and we toss a few coins to those who prove their guts.
Anyfin' I need ta know bout da big fightz?
Walk me through how Grozkarak are done.
Iz der sumfin' special bout scrappin in da pitz?
How do you run warm-ups?
So wot ya sayin' iz I get ta keep any teef I knock out?
No dawi throws gal away, what’s your return?
Nuff talkin! I got betta fings ta do!
Enough said, let's get into it.
Wot you want?
Well, lad?

There's a few boyz who likes ta bet a couple o' teef on da scraps we got goin' on. But da big fights draws boyz from all ova'! Da boyz luv da big fights an' dey cough up lotsa teef to da biggest boyz beat each uvva up
A few will wager on sparring, but the Grozkazak is what draws the true regard. The vithang backs it generously, and those who can carry their courage through the bout get their share.
Da rulez iz da same across all da camps. Either yoo is part o' a team or yoo iz not, we decides by pulling squig teef.
The rules are much the same across the Karaz Ankor. Names go in, lots come out. One round you’ll have kin at your side, the next you’ll be fighting on your own.
Da teef also says what gear yoo's usin'. If ya win, ya move up ta fight in da next scrap
Weapons are by lot, same as the matchups. Winners go on; the final pair settle the crown.
If yoo wants ta scrap yoo's can git there an' start fightin' anyone yoo sees. It ends when there's only 'un boy left standin'. Fun, huh?
The sparring is simple. All in, no teams, no breaks; until there’s only one left on his feet.
Is there anyfin' shiny fer winning 'unna dem big fightz?
How large is the purse for the Grozkazak?
Wotcha get from pit scrappin'?
Any gal for the sparring?
Right den... I fink I get it!
Alright then. I understand.
I wanna get ta bashin'!
Put my name in, then.
Right den! Da ladz iz already at it in da pitz! Just 'op right in an' get ta swingin'!
If you’re set on it, step in lad. There’s a sparring going on; now or later, your choice.
Den get in da pit ya git! Cause if ye try swingin' on me I'll crack yer jaw!
The hall’s open to tough beards. There’s sparring underway; step in, or return for the Grozkazak.
Ye wanna know da rulez o' da pit?
Is there anything else?
Wotcha feel like, den?
Tell me what you need.
Get me in da big fight! I'm tryin' ta scrap!
I would enter my name for the Grozkazak!
I's itchin' ta hit somefing, get me in da pitz!
My az hand itches, is there a sparring bout I could join?
So ya 'eard 'bout any o' dem big fightz 'round 'ere?
Is there another Grozkazak in any nearby holds?
Bout dat fing you said...
Just a moment ago, you said...
Den get in there an' quit ya yammerin'!
Be on, then. Grab a blunted weapon and remember the rules.
Da pitz iz bein' used for da big fight right now. Come back lata!
There is no sparring during the Grozkazak.
Good, ya lookin' right proppa for da big fight! Now get in there an' bash some 'eadz!
Alright then. Your name will be written. Honour to you.
Right den.
Eh, nevamind!
Perhaps I should not, this time.
Dun worry, I'll be ready!
I stand ready.
Changed me mind, dun wanna do it!
Given more thought to it, I must decline.
Ye, why not?
I see no reason to refuse.
Nah, I's got betta fingz ta do den fight dese wimpz!
Aye, lad, I would love to. But let's save this for another day.
Pah! Runt.
Your ancestor must look disappointed at you.
An' if ya wants to know 'ow ta 'old a choppa da proppa way ya come see me, we's got all kindsa boyz ya can pick up "tek neeks" from
There is much to learn in this place. If you watch the Langktrommi closely, you might learn a thing or two. You could ask one of them to help you improve.
Dese lads wiv "tek neeks" are dey about?
Which of the honourable Langktrommi has the time and where would I find him?
Right, you mean fer you or anovva?
Right then. Is it you that needs assistance or one of your Ongruni?
Fer me, ya git!
Aye, that's for me.
Fer dat git ova there, {COMPANION.NAME}
Aye, for my Ongrun {COMPANION.NAME}.
You fink you can teach 'unna my boyz a fing or two?
Most honoured one, could you help one of my Ongruni improve their abilities?
Ye I can give 'em a few scarz! Whoz it den?
Sure thing, who needs improvement?
Ah, wait, not dat 'un...
How about something different?
Eh, nevamind...
Forget it.
Wot "Tek neek" iz dis?
Please explain this technique, what does it entail?
I want somefing else.
No, I don't need that, I need something else.
Not now!
Nuf nu.
I know's a lad, what "tek neek" you finkin'?
Of course. What is it they should learn?
I wants {SKILL_NAME}.
{SKILL_NAME} would be best.
I want somefin' else.
Maybe something else instead.
Not now!
Maybe another time.
If yoo's gots {GOLD_AMOUNT} {GOLD_ICON}, I'll show ya!
For the right amount of {GOLD_AMOUNT} {GOLD_ICON} I can show you.
I'm sure.
Not rite now.
I must decline.
Gud, wot else?
Durak! What else can I aid you with?
I wants to work on anuvver "tek neek".
I need improvement in a different field.
I wants 'unna me boyz to learn a "tek neek".
One of my Ongruni needs to improve in a certain field.
Dat's enuff!
You have done more than I could ask for, you have my gratitude.
I's gettin' outta 'ere.
I have to bid you farewell.
I 'avent 'eard any big fights 'round 'ere. Doubt there will be 'un fer a bit!
Our axes rest now. You should as well.
I 'aven't bashed a skull in a bit... Yer'z will 'ave ta do!
My axe will taste your blood today!
Yoo's a lucky git! We's not in a bashin' mood... yet.
Stop, let's be gnol today. We can come to an agreement.
You'z not even worth me worst choppa! Git outta ere'!
I'm not going to waste my time with you. You can go.
Oi! Lookz like you'z got a lotta ladz! Mind if we join yaz for a scrap er two?
A wise dawi knows when he's defeated. Will you accept us into your army?
Yoo's a lucky git! We's not in a bashin' mood... yet.
A dawi never gives up his life without a fight!
Get in line wiv' da rest o' da ladz if ya know what'z good for ya...
Together we'll be stronger, no doubt. But I'll be watching you.
I's don't need weak fings like you in da mob!
You dare insult my intelligence? You will pay dearly for this grudge!
Only fing youz' worth iz' practice for me choppa!
Never. My honor demands that accounts be settled here and now.
Get outta ere'!
It doesn't matter.
W-we wuzn't tryin' ta kill ya, haha... We was just uh, elpin' you practice! No ard' feelinz ey?
Stay calm. Please treat us with dignity.
I ain't gonna be pushed around by a git like you! C'mere den! Gork n' Mork gonna dance on ya corpse!
Wanaz! If we have to die today, we will do so fighting.
We's got more killin ta do diz way! C'mon boyz!
We do not fret bloodshed, but it is good we could avoid this unnecessary conflict. Farewell.
You'z not gettin away dat eazee!
That's a Grudge for trying to bribe us, and another Grudge for offering too little!
What you be doin 'ere? Need somefin?
Greetings, what can I do for you?
I's needin' some new iron, an' I 'eard your da git ta go ta!
I would like to use your grungronazi.
I got somefin' betta ta do.
Nuf nu.
Diz betta work! 'eres ya teef den!
That's not bad Okrul, I suppose you've earned this.
Don't ya worry! Dat'z a nice proppa piece that!
Good pay for good work, that is how I like it. Anything else I can do for you?
I need ye ta make me anovva' fing!
I want to employ you for another piece.
I'm outta 'ere!
Oi! Wanna try somefin? Found a fing wot lookz interestin! Tink da 'umiez call it {GAME_NAME}, wanna try it?
How about a round of {GAME_NAME}, Barak Varr ruleset? Maybe with a little Dar?
I'd 'ave you swallow yer own teef 'for I touch dat 'umie fing ya git!
Nai, maybe another time.
Huh, not bad... wanna try dis {GAME_NAME} again?
Another round? You know you cannae stand on one leg.
Need somefin?
What can I do for you?
You 'eard bout anyfin' worth sum teef?
What news of the Urbazi?
Now, wot else ye be needin'?
Can I do something else for you?
Ye, I wanna know 'bout...
`Tell me about...
Nah! Get outta me face!
Safe travels, may Valaya watch over you.
Ah, nevamind!
Ah, nothing.
Don't tell me ye wanna talk more...
What else do you need of us dawi?
Shut it, n' tell me 'bout what loot ye got!
I'm something of a trader meself. Tell me, what wares do you peddle?
You been 'round! What do da ladz be wantin' dez dayz?
Tell me about your Drinit. What news of the Urbazi?
Right den!
Thank you for your Gnul.
We done 'ere? Or do I gotta listen to ya yap more?
Of course. Any more questions?
Oi! Drop ye loot or get ready ta scrap!
I suggest you hand over whatever you carry, or else this will get very ugly.
Eh, ye not worth da time anyway!
Never mind, I have no use for that umgak.
Great, now get out me way! Da boss be wantin' da rest o' dis loot!
Good, good. Another successful business.
Ye, ye, whateva!
Valaya bless the Drini you walk.
You fink we's just gonna let ya take our loot eh? Ye sooner get me choppa in yer 'ead! [rf:idle_angry][ib:aggressive]
We are sworn to protect this caravan and its contents.
Good, I wuz itchin' fer a fight!
Alright then. Dawi, attack!
Nah, doubt ye got any good lootz anyway, now get!
We're not looking for a fight, rest easy. Ancestors smile upon ya.
Da boss be expectin dis loot but, 'spose we coulda lost dis on da way. {TAKE_MONEY_AND_PRODUCT_STRING} [rf:idle_angry][ib:nervous]
Though it pains me to part with my gold, I suppose I can make more if I stay alive.
Ye, best start leggin' it den. Don't want your boss ta get too angry...
It is... acceptable.
Nah, ye loot wagons look like dey got some shineyz in there. I's gonna take 'em all!
Give me all ya got in there!
Lookin' at ye wagons... feel like ye boss iz gonna give ye more problems den me. Get outta 'ere!
You misunderstood. Listen more closely next time, and now git!
Great! Lookz like da scrapz comin ta us boyz, get ya choppaz ready! [rf:idle_angry][ib:aggressive]
Curse be upon you, we'll die before ye take what's ours!
R-right 'den... Ye can take a look in da wagons. Stand down boyz!
Shame on me, but this is a fight we cannae win. Take what you want and hope that we won't settle this grudge during your lifetime.
Ya loot wagons iz mine now, you 'ear?
Wel'll take that now, and we're not asking.
Lookz like you're mine now!
You're our guests now. Don't worry, we will treat you according to your... status.
Youz done it now! Da boyz in {KINGDOM} ain't gonna take lightly to losin' deir loot wagons!
The {KINGDOM} shall hear about this! There'll be grudges written about you for this plundering!
Gork n' Mork! Protect uz!
Ancestors, guide our axes against their filth!
Go on now.
Neva mind!
Forget it.
We's leavin' now er wot?
Can we get moving now?
We's leavin' now er wot?
Can we get moving now?
Afta' me!
Let's go together.
Go off an' do yer fing!
Stop! Separate yourselves.
Go get da ladz n' get back ere'!
Summon our thanes and seek me out in the settlement.
All o' youz get back ta what you waz doin!
Enough. You can return to your business.
Right boss!
By my honour!
Afta' you boss!
I shall follow you.
No problem boss!
Yes, my thane.
Alright boss!
Yes, my thane.
Lemme see da ladz'!
Let me take a gander at our company.
Oi, boss! I need ta say somefing!
{TITLE}, there is something we need to talk about.
No problem boss!
Ai, anu!
I's got a new job fer ye...
There is something else you could do for the clan...
I dun want a weaklin like you runnin round 'ere no more.
You are relieved of your position.
You'z gettin a promotion!
Your skills are better suited for this position.
Ta wot, boss?
What position to you have in mind?
Eh... I forgot, doesn't matta!
Ah, nuf.
No more tinkerin' fer you!
I have no need for your dibnin.
Your 'ealin' dayz iz ovva!
Your healing displeases Valaya.
You'z no longa camp boss!
I no longer need you as Throngvithang.
I dun need a scout no more!
I no longer need you as Undi.
Fine, den!
Ai, I'll do that.
Anyfin' fer you boss!
Your wish is my order.
Neva mind!
Ah, nuf.
I 'eard somefin ye might wanna 'ear!
There's a special assignment for you.
Whatcha need boss?
What is it you need me to do?
I need ya ta gatha more boyz!
I need more Kazaki for the Throng.
I'm feelin 'ungry, go get some food!
Supplies are low, I need you to gather some food.
Youz gonna scout round 'ere for da enemy, got it?
Establish some Undi in the area.
Neva mind!
Ah, nuf.
As you say boss! But eh... should I take any o' da ladz?
Ai, I shall do this. Can you spare some Kazaki forthis task?
Ye, take some o' da boyz wiv ye.
Take these Kazaki with you.
Wot? Can't do it alone? Get outta 'ere for I break ye jaw!
These Kazaki are needed elsewhere, you have to do this on your own.
W-wot? Whateva I did boss I didn't mean ta trouble ya!
Are you sure?
I didn't ask if ya meant ta, ya did! Now get outta my face for I cave your'z in!
Your age is now more than that of any Langktrommi I know. You should let yourself enjoy some rest.
I've 'ad enuff 'o you makin problemz 'round da camp, now get goin!
You're an Ufdi and not suited for this company. It would be better if you left.
Ya spend more time fightin' da ladz den anyone else. So less ya wanna fight me, den get ta walkin'.
You're a wazzock and I have no need for you.
You'z noffin but a weak git! Now scram less ye wanna fight!
I thought you'd be more skilled. Now I know I was mistaken.
You'z shoulda seen da look on ya face! Now get back in line ya git!
Forgive me, I confused what I wanted to say with what I thought.
Right boss! You'z a funny 'un...! [if:convo_nervous][ib:normal2]
Seems Gork an' Mork favor you today! I've got somefin' for ya...
You've earned yourself a Wulthrung.
Can't do it, boss! I's still da boss o' da ovva loot wagon ya got!
You honor me with this request, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}Rinn{?}Rik{\?}. Yet, I'm duty-bound to lead this caravan to safety. Release me of this oath and we'll discuss it furter.
I already knew dat, stoopid! I wuz testin' yoo. When yer done movin' dat stuff, yoo'll get more work.
Of course, a dawi who leaves his tasks is no good. Carry on then, we shall talk later.

Ere we go 'Ere we go! I'm a BIG boss now! I won't let you down boss! I's gonna crunch em an' stomp em an' smash em, an' I's gonna make my forts da 'ardest forts you'z ever seen! Just wait fer it! An' when you say da word, I's gonna come an' help you WAAAGH!

My thanks, {?PLAYER.GENDER}Rinn{?}Rik{\?}. I long awaited the chance to carve out a hold of my own. With the wealth to keep the forges burning, I shall find a worthy mate and bring some good lads back to the Karaz Ankor. Best of all, I would lead a throng of kin to settle our grudges...
You'z a proppa good scrappa! I fink it's time fer ya own fort!
Aye. You have proven yourself to the Ancestors and to me. You'll get your kazad, may it guard your kin and let your beard grow long and grey.
Um, boss? We don' got no free fort ta give.
My {?PLAYER.GENDER}rinn{?}rik{\?}, I'm honoured by the offer but you hold no kazad to grant me yet. A dawi cannot rule empty air and high hopes.
Shut up, stoopid! I wuz talkin' 'bout when we gotz one. Duh.
I take your point. Let's carve the foundation of our hold first, eh? We'll talk about this when we have a hall to call ours, dawongi.
Smart! Dat's why yer da boss!
As you say, my Rik.
Ya mean it, boss? Which fort wuz you meanin'?
And where is that hold exactly?
Wait! not dat 'un!
Hmm, I was thinking of some other place.
Now dat I fink on it... nevamind!
I've thought better of it, your axe is needed by my side for now.
Right! Thankz boss! Iz gonna whip those boyz at {SETTLEMENT_NAME} inta proppa shape for ye!
{SETTLEMENT_NAME}? Valaya's hearth, you honour me, {?PLAYER.GENDER}Rinn{?}Rik{\?}.I hereby swear upon my beard to guard this halls until Gazul himself claims me.[ib:hip][if:convo_happy]
See dat ya do {CULTURE_SPECIFIC_TITLE} {COMPANION_NAME} now, go teach da boyz at {SETTLEMENT_NAME} whoz in charge!
I bestow upon ye the rank of {CULTURE_SPECIFIC_TITLE} and the duty to safeguard the hold of {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. May you make the Ancestors proud.
Oi, 'old on! Lemme fink 'bout it sum!
Right. I need some more time to ponder the issue.
Oi, boss! Now we's a proper mob, but wot ya want to call us boyz?
My {?PLAYER.GENDER}Rinn{?}Rik{\?}, establishing my clan will be a heavy burder. Would you lighten it by naming it?
Fanks boss, I'll keep it right in me noggin for da next time ya need me. We's always wiv ya!
You have my thanks, {?PLAYER.GENDER}Rinn{?}Rik{\?}. My kin and I will keep your deed close to our heart. We shall never forget it while the mountains still stand.
Dat iz some big finkin' alright. No worries, boss, I'll stick wiv ya until you'z figure it out!
A hold is a weighty matter, my {PLAYER.GENDER}Rinn{?}Rik{\?}, better to measure your stone twice before cutting, aye? My oath to you is still standing, you'll still find me at your side!
Fanks boss! Now I can get back ta smashin!
I owe you a life debt for saving me.
Course boss, jus' doin me job, guardin da boss!
I do anything to strike a grudge from the books.
Wot now?
What is next?
Let's get back wiv da ladz an' keep goin.
We should concentrate our forces with the others, a dawi's strength lies in the shieldwall.
I need you'z ta lead some'a da boyz.
I need you to lead a throng of your own.
There ain't no place for ya now.
Aye, there's a little complication with you coming along right now. I'd like you to remain on your own for now.
Which boyz am I da boss uv?
Which throng needs leadership?
It's good ta be back!
I am glad to fight alongside you once more!
I's a lone wolf, but I's remembah wot ya did fer me.
I'll continue on my own, but I will remember the debt I owe you!
Woteva you say boss!
Sure, I will.
Wotcha want me ta do boss?
What shall I do for you?
We'll get goin!
Beards in belts, we're gonna march out now.
Go on, I's listenin'.
Go on, tell me. I'll listen.
Yeah, woteva. Maybe I'll rememba dat.
Your words ring true. I shall keep to them to avoid further grievances.
Oi, I's da 'un calling da shotz 'ere!
As much as I value your advice, I shall have to mull over it more.
You'z weak, you don' belong wiv me boyz.
We obviously have different views on honourable conduct. Maybe it'll be best to part ways.
Come ta fink o' it... I got too many boyz as iz!
Hmm...I've got more lads swingin' steel than I can keep in line already.
Fine... 'ere'z ya shinies, now go join da rest o' dem!
Here's your okstal...{GOLD_AMOUNT}, move it!
Hah! Like I'd give ya all dat! Fink again!
By my beard, that's more gold than I can spare!
Oi, got a job fer ye...
We've business to hammer out so listen up.
Wotcha want, boss?
Aye. What's gnawin' at your skull then?
What do da ladz want dese dayz?
What word from the trade-roads? Some good urbar to do?
Wot else ya want?
Anything else?
Anuvver fing ta speak about...
Aye, there's more we need to chew over.
Don't stand about gawpin', move it, ya gitz!
Off with you then.
Zog it.
Bah. Forget it.
Wot yoo want?
Spit it out.
If I catch you sneakin' about, we's gunna gut ya.
Now don't you try and do something stupid, you wattock. I'm very dangerous over short distance
Yer not gonna 'ave any problemz wiv me!
I swear it, by stone and steel.
I's gots nuffin' for ya, zog off!
Move along, there's nothing for you here. Leave me to my work.
Git away from me, before I krump ya.
Leave, wattock!
Da boyz been talkin 'bout yoo, if yoo keep actin up we's gunna put yoo down.
One more incident and you'll have yourself a grudge!
Wot yoo want, ya filcha?
What do you want, wanaz?
Wot? Can't yoo sees I's workin?
Aye? What is it you want?
Who ya got lokked up?
Who needed a time-out?
I wanna to speak to som'un ya got caged up.
I would like to speak with a prisoner here.
I wanna to speak to som'un ya got caged up.
I would like to speak with a prisoner here.
Zog it!
Ah, nuf.
{PRISONER_NAMES} {?IS_PLURAL}are{?}is{\?} all caged up like 'ere.
{PRISONER_NAMES} {?IS_PLURAL}are{?}is{\?} needed a little time-out.
Ain't no zoggin way I's lettin yoo in, da boss would 'ave me fed ta da squigs!
You have no right to be here. Get out before I tell my {?SETTLEMENT_OWNER.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\?} {SETTLEMENT_OWNER.NAME}.
Alrite, fine.
Aye, sure. Go in.
Ain't you da boss 'round 'ere?
I thought your word held more sway here?
Wot are yoo on about?
Stop mumbling and speak clear.
I found dis 'ere bag wiv gold inside, it's yours yeah?
Would you look at that, it seems you have lost your purse. As your long-time friend, I'll of course hand it over to you.
Zog it!
Ah, nuf.
Ain't no 'un in 'ere, now zog off.
The cells are empty. You should go, unless you want to occupy one yourself, he?
Aight, let's have a look.
Sure, I'll have a look at the inmates then.
Aight, let's have a look.
Sure, I'll have a look at the inmates then.
I's gots ovva fings ta do.
I don't have time for you.
I's gots ovva fings ta do.
I don't have time for you.
Right, I'll 'ave a go at dat den!
Aye, I'll try that.
Izzat so? I'll jus be countin' dese shineyz, an' when I's done yoo betta be gone!
How kind of you to return my purse to me. Let me count whether everything's in there, just to be safe. In the meantime, go on and take a stroll here.
An' over da keys before I krump ya!
Hand over the barmakaz now and no one will get hurt!
Da gits are escapin'! Git over 'ere ladz!
Sound the hirn, they're trying to get out!
Da boyz been talkin 'bout yoo, if yoo keep actin' up we's gonna pull out yer entrails!
One more incident and you'll have yourself a grudge!
Wot yoo want, ya filcha?
What do you want, wanaz?
Wot yoo want?
Aye, what can I do for you?
I wanna see da boss.
I request to see the rik.
